madrid.name: Comunidad de Madrid
madrid.verified_by: Scale and general personal minimum read verbatim from the BOE consolidated text of Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (art. 1 and art. 2; BOE consolidated texts are informative, the BOCM original was not read). Cross-checked: the 'cuota integra' column of the table matches the rates; AEAT Manual de Renta 2025 shows the identical scale; the Ministerio de Hacienda report 'Tributacion Autonomica. Medidas 2026' (updated 2026-09-23) states Madrid has five brackets, 8.50% to 20.50% above 57,320.40 and lists Madrid as unchanged vs 2025 (only Extremadura and Comunitat Valenciana changed their scale for 2026).

sources.doc: Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (BOCM 25-10-2010), consolidated text on BOE, art. 1 (scale) and art. 2 (minimum)
AEAT Manual practico de Renta 2025, Madrid autonomic scale (exercise 2025)
Ministerio de Hacienda, Tributacion Autonomica. Medidas 2026, chapter I, section 1.1 and annex I
sources.read: verbatim text; annex scale charts are images, only bracket count, min/max rate and last threshold are stated in text

notes: Madrid raises the personal minimum for the autonomic part only (5,956.65 vs 5,550 state); modelled for the general taxpayer minimum.
NOT modelled: regional deductions (rent, children, large family, etc.), autonomic minimums for age over 65/75, descendants, ascendants and disability, savings-base scale, joint filing.
A 2027 reduction of the autonomic bracket was announced in the press; it is not in the law texts read and does not apply to 2026.

cataluna.name: Cataluña
cataluna.verified_by: Scale read verbatim in two official texts: Decret-llei 5/2025 art. 3.1 (DOGC num. 9379, 26-3-2025, effective 2025-01-01) and the BOE consolidated Codi tributari de Catalunya art. 611-1 (consolidation published 2026-05-22), which also fixes the general personal minimum at 5,550 (art. 611-2). The 'cuota integra' column matches the rates; AEAT Manual de Renta 2025 shows the identical scale; the Ministerio de Hacienda report Medidas 2026 states eight brackets, 9.5% to 25.5% above 175,000 and no scale change vs 2025 for Cataluña. No deflation clause was found in the text of Decret-llei 5/2025 (a third-party newsletter claimed one; not used).

comunitat_valenciana.name: Comunitat Valenciana
comunitat_valenciana.verified_by: Scale read verbatim in Ley 5/2026 de 31 de julio, art. 18 (DOGV num. 10425, 10-8-2026, page 23, copy hosted by BOE; effective for events accruing from 2026-01-01) and in the BOE consolidated Ley 13/1997 art. 2, which also fixes the general personal minimum at 6,105 (art. 2 bis). The 'cuota integra' column matches the rates. The corrección de errores DOGV-r-2026-90216 only restates the preamble. Hacienda's Medidas 2026 report states eleven brackets, 8.8% to 29.35% above 200,000 and that Comunitat Valenciana lowered every bracket for 2026.

andalucia.name: Andalucía
andalucia.verified_by: Scale and general personal minimum read verbatim from the BOE consolidated Ley 5/2021 de Tributos Cedidos (art. 23 and art. 23 bis; BOE consolidated text is informative, the BOJA original was not read). The Ley 8/2025 de Presupuesto 2026 (BOJA 31-12-2025) was read and changes deductions only, not the scale. The 'cuota integra' column matches the rates; AEAT Manual de Renta 2025 shows the identical scale; the Ministerio de Hacienda report Medidas 2026 states five brackets, 9.5% to 22.5% above 60,000 and no scale change vs 2025.

cantabria.name: Cantabria
cantabria.verified_by: Scale read verbatim from the BOE consolidated Decreto Legislativo 62/2008 art. 1 and in Ley 3/2023 art. 3.Uno (BOE-A-2024-1373, the amendment that set six brackets); both tables are identical and the 'cuota integra' column matches the rates. Ley de Cantabria 5/2026 (BOE-A-2026-10431) was searched and does not touch the scale. AEAT Manual de Renta 2025 shows the identical scale; the Ministerio de Hacienda report Medidas 2026 states six brackets, 8.50% to 24.50% above 90,000 and no scale change vs 2025. Cantabria is not among the communities that regulate their own personal minimum, so the state minimum applies.
